behavior: While `Drawer.VirtualKeyboardProvider` holds the space for the keyboard on a scroll container, it watches the `style` attribute of that element. When a render or a script replaces a declaration of the provider, the provider keeps the new value for the restore and writes its declaration again before the next frame. In Base UI, a new `padding-bottom` of the consumer replaces the space until the next alignment, and the restore then writes the value from before the keyboard over it.
